slots_and_copies.name: active_window_0x7000
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Demonstrated to be a byte-exact mirror of this cartridge's own ROM header (verified via the public GBA header checksum formula); not a save slot/copy in the game-save sense.

fields.name: unidentified_fragment_0x5000
fields.update_mechanism: unknown; no traced writer/reader in ghidra/decompiled.c or ghidra/callgraph.json references any save-hardware address at all
fields.evidence: saves/cap-00-future-0.sav offset 0x5000-0x5012; remainder of the 0x5000-0x5FFF window is zero padding, distinct from the file's 0xFF background fill.

fields.name: rom_header_mirror_block
fields.update_mechanism: Not written by any traced game function. Byte-exact match to this cartridge's own GBA ROM header (entry branch + header fields), independently verified against the public GBA header-checksum formula. Interpreted as an open-bus/ROM-mirroring capture artifact rather than genuine save content.
fields.evidence: saves/cap-00-future-0.sav offset 0x7000-0x7FFF; Python verification: sum=-(bytes[0xA0:0xBD]) then (sum-0x19)&0xFF == 0xbe == stored byte at relative offset 0xbd (absolute 0x70bd).

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Alter one ASCII byte of the mirrored title string at 0x70a0-0x70ac (e.g. 'KARNAAJ' -> 'KARNAAX').
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: No observable gameplay/UI change expected if this window is a pure ROM-mirror capture artifact with no traced reader; any observed change would falsify that hypothesis.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Zero all 19 non-zero bytes at 0x5000-0x5012, and separately flip the little-endian u16 at relative offset 0x0a-0x0b (bytes '88 13' = 5000 decimal) to 0x0000.
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If this fragment is live save data, expect an observable difference (e.g. reset high score/unlock/settings default) after a fresh load versus an unmodified control load with matched frame-count duration. If it is also capture noise, expect no observable difference.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Force the entire backup-media backing store to a constant 0xff (simulating an erased/absent save chip) and compare observable state against loading cap-00-future-0.sav unmodified.
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If this title has no functioning/exercised battery-backed save path in the traced build, no observable difference should appear between the two conditions.

open_questions: True backup-media type and capacity are unconfirmed; no SRAM/Flash/EEPROM driver code was found anywhere in the 47-function trace-guided decompilation (ghidra/decompiled.c) or the 0-seed ghidra/save_related_functions.c extraction.

Whether this title exercises any battery-backed save path at all during normal play is unresolved; packet metadata already notes 'SDK Save Tags in ROM: none detected' and 'Observed Save Media: unknown', and this task found no contradicting code evidence.

The origin mechanism of the 0x7000-0x7FFF ROM-header mirror inside the .sav capture (open-bus read, emulator mapping quirk, or capture-tool artifact) was not determined; only its byte-identity to the ROM header was proven.
The meaning (if any) of the 19-byte fragment at 0x5000-0x5012 is unresolved; no decompiled function or callgraph node could be attributed as a writer or reader for it.

No paired .ss save states were available for this release (states/ is empty), which blocks any reload-based counterfactual verification of the fuzzing plan in Section 6 of SAVE-FORMAT-REPORT.md until a fresh capture with mandatory paired pre/post save states is run.
Only one .sav sample was available; redundancy/mirroring/selection-rule claims cannot be tested without a second sample or state-paired before/after captures.
